notes: Two separate groups are correct for this manual. The booklet builds two independent models: a small tree scene (p64, p33, p8, cat p59, fish p60, booklet steps 1-3) and the fire chief car (steps 4-36). They share no physical connection and the booklet never joins them. I left them unconnected rather than invent a join.
The fish p60 is tied to the tree base only through the minifigure that holds it. Minifigures are not in the piece list, so that join is a loose placeholder.

Steps are counted through the booklet: tree = steps 1-3, car steps 1-23 = booklet steps 4-36; sub-assembly sub-steps are counted individually. Repeated '2x' builds use the same step number for both copies.

The door plates p23/p24 sit on top of the slope bricks p47/p48 (layer 6) because the grid model has no recess. The car is offset one stud in x so the hood wedge p1 sits in front of the cabin without overlapping p29, p47 or p48.

Sideways pieces (tail lights, number plate, grille, headlight slopes, bumper, wheels, windscreens, radio, sticker) have position null and are recorded in other_joins. Wheel holders attach under the base (model shown upside down), so they are null-positioned and joined to the base.

Grid coordinates are approximate. x runs front to rear, y across the 4-wide body. The bracket pieces p3 and p4 have unclear footprints, and the hood stack (p29, p1, p34, p35, p44, p45) was inferred from small illustrations. p44 and p45 are listed as resting on p1, although the catalogue gives p1 only anti-studs. This is a modelling approximation.

The windscreens carry no ports in the catalogue, so they are null-positioned. The roof p72 rests on them, with its position inferred. The sticker sheet p2 is placed at step 20, though the roof sticker is applied later.
